short_description: Explainable defensive analysis of user-supplied suspicious URLs, messages, signals, and Evidence Ledgers.
long_description: RUMBO Guardian analyzes user-supplied URLs and text for phishing, fraud, impersonation, and suspicious-navigation indicators without browsing to the destination. It explains technical evidence and can verify exported Evidence Ledger hash chains. Scores are advisory evidence summaries rather than guarantees or accusations.
starter_prompts: Analyze this URL for phishing indicators without opening it.
Analyze this suspicious message and explain the evidence.
Verify whether this exported Evidence Ledger hash chain is intact.
